CustomField.formula:
/*IF( UnitPrice != 0.00, SUBSTITUTE(TEXT(ROUND(UnitPrice, 2)), ".", ",") & IF(MOD(UnitPrice, 1) = 0, ",00", IF(LEN(TEXT(ROUND(UnitPrice, 2))) - FIND(".", TEXT(ROUND(UnitPrice, 2))) = 1, "0", "")) & " €", SUBSTITUTE(TEXT(ROUND(Discount * 100, 2)), ".", ",") & IF(MOD(Discount * 100, 1) = 0, ",00", IF(LEN(TEXT(ROUND(Discount * 100, 2))) - FIND(".", TEXT(ROUND(Discount * 100, 2))) = 1, "0", "")) & " %" )*/
IF( BLANKVALUE(UnitPrice, 0) <> 0, /* Preis-Zweig: 12,34 € */ IF( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ApprovalLevel__c))), "🔖 ", "🏷️ " ) & SUBSTITUTE( TEXT(FLOOR(ROUND(UnitPrice, 2))) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT( MOD( ROUND(UnitPrice * 100, 0), 100) ), 2), ".", "," ) & " €", /* Rabatt-Zweig: 12,34 % (Discount z. B. 0,1234 = 12,34 %) */ IF( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(ApprovalLevel__c))), "🔖 ", "🏷️ " )& SUBSTITUTE( TEXT(FLOOR(ROUND(Discount * 100, 2))) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT( MOD( ROUND(Discount * 100 * 100, 0), 100) ), 2), ".", "," ) & " %" )
CustomField.label: Condition / Discount
